name: Oven Chicken Parmesan with Penne

components.name: Chicken Parmesan Cutlets

ingredients.name: Raw boneless chicken breasts, split into 6 cutlets

steps: Heat oven to 210 C. Pound chicken cutlets to even thickness, season with dried herbs, salt and pepper.
Set out separate shallow dishes for flour, beaten egg with garlic, and panko mixed with parmesan. Coat each chicken cutlet in flour, egg and then panko.
Lay coated cutlets on an oiled wire rack over a tray; drizzle or spray with measured olive oil and bake until crisp and chicken reaches 74 C.
Spoon a little tomato sauce over each cooked cutlet, top with measured mozzarella and parmesan, and bake a few minutes more until cheese melts.

components.name: Penne
steps: Boil 330 g dry penne and drain well. Portion penne and chicken; pack remaining tomato sauce separately to maintain coating crispness.

components.name: Tomato Sauce
steps: Meanwhile, briefly cook onion and garlic in a saucepan, add passata and stock and simmer to thicken.
